description: Manuscript set A regime map: D_s x b_R. The outrun threshold D_s,crit ~ 6 separates fast waves from fronts that meet their primed band; there, b_R < 1 stalls and b_R > 1 gives a slow wave (§ 3.10, Table 7). Abortive extinction threshold: R0 = b_R < 1 at full priming. Uses the manuscript density cutoff (no infection below V_ext = p_ext, removal at rate 5); without it, stalls restart by non-physical tail tunnelling.

expected.D_s > ~6, b_R > 1: wave_halo (or unsteady without a density cutoff)
